# /crav1-review-pr

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From a pull request review](../../from-review-pr.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-review-pr/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Read one named open pull request and report whether it can ship.

## Runs when

This turn names an open pull request. Called by the user.

## Reads

In short: The pull request, its diff, and the spec.

Reads one named open pull request, its diff, the spec, the body, and the required linter. When the slug has `plan.md`, also reads the plan and `verify.md`. When the slug has no `plan.md` or `tasks.md`, reads the pipeline's recorded test results instead and does not treat a missing `verify.md` as a finding.

## Writes

In short: Nothing.

Writes nothing.

## Does not

Leaves code, the spec, the plan, comments, and the merge alone.

Limits and exceptions: spark, specify, verify, [`/crav1-open-pr`](crav1-open-pr.md), and [`/crav1-merge-pr`](crav1-merge-pr.md) do not run it. An outside pull request names [`/crav1-keep-current`](crav1-keep-current.md) after merge and does not run it.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-merge-pr`](crav1-merge-pr.md); [`/crav1-keep-current`](crav1-keep-current.md) after an outside pull request merges
- Runs by itself: Calls no skill.

## Lane and group

Lane: Cross-cutting. Group: Commit and pull request. Starter option: no. Routing: [guild routing](../../guild-routing.md).

## Stage and since

Stage: stable. Since: 1.6.0 ([changelog](../../../CHANGELOG.md)).

## First prompt

```text
/crav1-review-pr
https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/pull/<n>

Read the diff. Do not edit. Do not run the tests. Do not merge.
```
